releases.body:
LinBox bionic rootfs 专用 Box64（aarch64 / NDK bionic 链接 / -DANDROID=ON / ARM_DYNAREC）

- bionic ELF（PT_INTERP=/system/bin/linker64），与 rootfs 内
  wine / mesa / pulseaudio 等二进制同链同形态；box64 本体零
  glibc 依赖
- 完整安装集（不再只有单个 box64 执行文件）：
  `usr/local/bin/box64` + `usr/bin/box64` PATH 入口链接
  + `usr/lib/box64-x86_64-linux-gnu/libc++_shared.so`
  （上游 ANDROID 模式配套，被仿真 x86_64 程序的 C++ 标准库）
  + `usr/etc/box64.box64rc`（系统级调优开关）
  + `usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/`（`ld-linux-aarch64.so.1`
  私有加载器与 aarch64 glibc 运行库 —— glibc 形态 box64
  与 rootfs 内 glibc 二进制的运行层）
  + `usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/`（被仿真 x86_64 程序的
  glibc 运行库，box64 经 BOX64_LD_LIBRARY_PATH 查找）
- 手动安装: 解包 `linbox-box64-*.tar.gz` 至 /（data/data/com.linbox/...
  自动就位），或 `linbox-container install-box64 <tar.gz|URL>`
- 安装后 linbox-container 自动探测 /usr/local/bin/box64
- 用途: 在 aarch64 设备上运行 x86_64 Wine（backend=box64）；
  v0.4.4 为 hangover-11.16 官方配套版本（错配可致 wineboot SEH 级联崩溃）
- 注意: 与完整 rootfs 包（build-bionic-rootfs）同源 —— rootfs 已内置
  同款 box64 与配套文件，单独升级时才需要本包

Bayonetta 3 Recomp v0.3.17
releases.body:
Know before you set up: the app and the launchers now check whether your device can run the game.

## New

- **A minimum spec, checked for you.** Below it, setting up takes 30 to 60 minutes and can end in a black screen, so the app and launchers now say so first. Below the minimum they stop by default and explain why, with a choice to try anyway. If a device only falls short of the recommended spec, you get a warning.
  - **Android:** the app checks when it opens and again before **SET UP** or **START**. Minimum: Vulkan 1.3, a CPU core at 2.4 GHz or faster, 6 GB of memory, and an Adreno 640 / Mali-G68 class GPU or newer. Older Mali GPUs (G31 to G76), Mali-T, PowerVR and Maleoon are below it. Recommended: Snapdragon 8 Gen 1 or newer with 8 GB.
  - **Send to my phone** checks the phone before it builds anything, and asks before sending to a phone below the minimum (`b3_win.py phone --anyway` on the command line).

releases.name: Bayonetta 3 Recomp v0.3.16
releases.body:
A second fix for the GPU hang in heavy scenes on Android and Steam Deck.

## Fixed

- **A full upload buffer no longer hangs the GPU** ([#10](https://github.com/aoxzh/bayo3-recomp/issues/10)). v0.3.15 gave each frame the whole buffer, but a heavy enough frame could still fill it, and the game then overwrote data the GPU was still reading. Now the rest of such a frame goes into extra memory of its own, freed a few frames later, and nothing in use is overwritten. This works the way the Witch-Time project handles the same case. In a test with a deliberately tiny buffer, the old code hung within a minute; the new one kept playing with steady memory use. The log line is now `upload ring full (… MB in this submit): the rest of it goes to blocks of its own`, with a summary every 60 frames. `NX_RING_OVERFLOW=0` in `config.txt` brings back the old behaviour.

## Coming from v0.3.15

- **Desktop:** unpack over the old folder and choose **Rebuild** in the launcher. Saves and settings stay.
- **Android:** install the new APK over the old one, then **SET UP** again (or **Send to my phone** from a computer that has the game). Saves and game files in `Internal storage/Bayonetta 3` stay.

releases.name: Bayonetta 3 Recomp v0.3.15
releases.body:
A fix for a GPU hang on Android and Steam Deck in heavy scenes.

## Fixed

- **GPU hang after "upload buffer full"** ([#10](https://github.com/aoxzh/bayo3-recomp/issues/10)). On Android and on Linux with an integrated GPU (Steam Deck), a frame could only use half of the upload buffer: the previous frame's data stayed reserved longer than it was needed. In a scene with heavy uploads the buffer filled, the frame overwrote data the GPU was still reading, and the game stopped with `GPU hang (a submit did not finish in 2 s)`. That reserved part is now released as soon as it has been read, so the whole buffer is available. Windows with a discrete GPU was not affected.

## Coming from v0.3.14

- **Desktop:** unpack over the old folder and choose **Rebuild** in the launcher. Saves and settings stay.
- **Android:** install the new APK over the old one, then **SET UP** again (or **Send to my phone** from a computer that has the game). Saves and game files in `Internal storage/Bayonetta 3` stay.

releases.name: Bayonetta 3 Recomp v0.3.14
releases.body:
Easier setup on every platform: a guided setup, a faster route to Android from a computer, and a one-click bug report.

## New

- **Send to my phone** (desktop launcher, or `b3_win.py phone`): a computer that has already set the game up builds the Android version itself, then copies it over USB. It installs the app, copies the game data and hands over the game. This takes a few minutes instead of 30 to 60 minutes of setup on the phone. You need USB debugging on. Some phones (vivo, Xiaomi) ask you to confirm the install on the screen, so keep the phone unlocked.
- **Setup guide** (desktop): the first setup is now a step-by-step window. It says how to extract your own copy with your emulator, finds extractions on the computer and checks each one: is it update 1.2.0, are ExeFS and RomFS both present, is the RomFS complete. Start setup is enabled only for a good one. The recomp does not decrypt anything: you extract the files from your own copy with your emulator.
- **Report a bug** (desktop and Android): makes the report zip and opens a new GitHub issue with the version, system and GPU filled in. Attach the zip and describe the problem.

releases.name: Bayonetta 3 Recomp v0.3.13
releases.body:
## Fixed

- **The title screen's models turned white after leaving stage select** (#6). The title's new lighting cube map has
  the same address, format and size as the stage-select one, so it shared that GPU image and was never read from
  game memory again: the title was lit with stage-select's lighting. A texture that takes over a shared image now
  reads it again. Checked on Windows (RTX) and Adreno 740.
  `NX_SHARE_REUPLOAD=0` in `config.txt` restores the old behaviour, for comparison.
- **Grass, bushes and leaves drawn as solid light-green blocks** (#7, e.g. at the start of Chapter 4). Foliage is
  drawn in two passes: a depth pass that discards the cards' transparent texels, then a colour pass that only draws
  where the depth is EQUAL. That EQUAL was run as LESS_OR_EQUAL (a workaround for a precision problem on Metal),
  so the colour pass also drew every transparent texel. EQUAL now stays EQUAL, as on the console, everywhere but
  Apple. Checked on Windows (RTX) and Adreno 740.
  `NX_EQUAL_AS_LEQUAL=1` restores the old behaviour. If you see new black edges or missing surfaces, please open an
  issue with a bug report.

## Coming from v0.3.12

releases.name: v0.2.7: Multi-region hooks, black models/cubemaps fix & NVN write-back/spill perf
releases.body:
## NieR:Automata Android Recomp v0.2.7

### Español
- **Soporte multi-región y fix de modelos negros (PR #26 / PR #27):** Resolución automática `ADRP+LDR` para USA y Asia 1.0.3 (presenter y resolución dinámica mínima `0.6`) y firma ampliada de 8 instrucciones en `mesh_draw_hook` para evitar falsos matches y modelos/naves en negro.
- **Corrección de reflejos/cubemaps negros:** Añadido `VK_IMAGE_CREATE_CUBE_COMPATIBLE_BIT` en texturas `2D_ARRAY` cuadradas de `6n` capas.
- **Optimizaciones de rendimiento NVN:** Salida rápida con `memcmp` + comparación SIMD NEON ARM64 en write-backs (`apply_write_back`), pool de snapshots (`g_before_pool`) y pool de buffers spill (`g_staging_pool`) para reducir pausas de CPU y asignaciones de memoria por frame.
- **Fix Android 10 (API 29) y diagonales en mando:** Guard de `InsetsController` para evitar crashes al iniciar en Android 10 y zona muerta radial 2D para sticks físicos.

---

### English
- **Multi-region hooks & black models fix (PR #26 / PR #27):** Automatic `ADRP+LDR` slot resolution across USA and Asia 1.0.3 builds (presenter & dynamic-res floor `0.6`) plus expanded 8-instruction `mesh_draw_hook` signature to prevent black 3D models/ships.

releases.name: v0.2.5: Fix continuous phantom dodge/evade & SixAxis decouple
releases.body:
## NieR:Automata for Android v0.2.5

### Fixes & Improvements / Correcciones y mejoras

- **Continuous Phantom Dodge/Evade Fixed / Corrección de esquiva/dash continuo fantasma (Fixes #13, #15, #18):**
  - **IHidServer IsSixAxisSensorAtRest (cmd 82):** Implemented Horizon OS nn::hid::IHidServer command 82, returning isAtRest = true. Previously, unhandled command 82 returned false, tricking the game into detecting constant controller movement and triggering endless motion-controlled evades/dashes.
  - **SixAxis Angular Velocity Decoupling:** Restricted right-stick gyro motion aiming simulation exclusively to Persona 5 Royal (Darts minigame). In NieR, the right stick controls the camera; feeding stick inputs into the virtual gyro was generating violent angular velocity spikes that triggered unwanted evade maneuvers when looking around.
  - **Versión oficial v0.2.5 (versionCode 7):** Se corrigió la esquiva automática e incontrolable del personaje al implementar el comando IPC IsSixAxisSensorAtRest y desacoplar la simulación giroscópica del stick derecho de la cámara.

releases.name: 3.0.6 - November 18, 2026
releases.body:
* Fixed GB, GBC and GBA games running slow on PAL (576i) 50Hz output
* Fixed JIT IRQ latency bug causing graphical artifacts
* **Restored the original controls of the games with special Wii controls** (Zelda, Mario, Metroid, Ninja Turtles, Mortal Kombat, Star Wars, Harry Potter, Medal of Honor, Boktai, The Lord of the Rings, Castlevania and the rest). releases.name: 3.0.5 - November 3, 2026
releases.body:
* **The left analog stick now moves the pointer in the menus**, on every controller, like a mouse. It no longer also steps through the buttons; the D-pad still does
* **A Wiimote with anything plugged into it is now always vertical in the menus**, and its buttons and IR pointer work alongside the extension (a Nunchuk on Wii and a Classic Controller on both Wii and Wii U previously lost them)
* **Redesigned Button Mappings screen.** One screen now replaces the separate controller and button screens, showing each button on a drawing of the controller and letting you choose a button by pressing it or from a list.

Snapshots fill a grid, with the game's **Cartridge Save** (shown only for games that have one) in its own card beneath. ## BioShock 1 Native Android ReComp — v0.0.7.9 Experimental

### Highlights & Fixes

- **Fixed Missing Initial Lighting / Pitch-Black Areas on Boot (No Longer Requires Tapping `RES`)**
  - Fixed Xenos `DI_PT_RECTLIST` clear redirection in `PrimaryColorTargetAt()` / `PrimaryDepthTargetAt()` so direct `msaa=0` clears are never stolen by wider targets sharing the same EDRAM base (`0x5a0` / `0x5b0`), and 4x-MSAA fast-clear aliases (`msaa=2`) only redirect to exact `pitch * 2` non-MSAA targets (`640→1280`, `280→560`, `80→160`).
  - Eliminated the giant solid-black tilted shadow-projector boxes caused by uncleared `0.0` dynamic shadow depth targets.
  - Initialized newly allocated `GL_DEPTH24_STENCIL8` depth targets and resolved depth surfaces to `1.0` (`ClearDepthTextureOne`) so fresh targets never read `0.0` or recycled VRAM garbage across boot, level loads, or live resolution switches.
  - Armed physical write watches on resolved surfaces, added periodic eviction of dead menu/loading-screen resolved targets (300+ idle frames), and rejected compressed DXT/BC texture fetches from matching stale resolved targets.

## BioShock 1 Native Android Port — v0.0.7.6 (Experimental)

A major **GPU + CPU performance** and **visual accuracy** update for the custom GLES 3.2 Xenos renderer, verified live on Samsung Galaxy A36 (Snapdragon 6 Gen 3 / Adreno 710):
- **Heavy flowing-water corridor:** **21–22 FPS → 46+ FPS** at 540p (`+109%`), **43+ FPS** at native 720p
- **Interiors & Medical Pavilion hallways:** **73–96 FPS** at 360p/540p

---

releases.name: v2.5.17 — Microsoft sign-in
releases.body:
## What's new

- **Microsoft sign-in no longer opens a blank white page** ([#3](https://github.com/FlameLaunchers/FlameLauncher-Android/issues/3)). Android's WebView puts `; wv` in its user agent, Microsoft reads that as an embedded browser and refuses the page — and what you get is not a message, it is an empty white screen. The marker is gone from the user agent now.

  Two more things the sign-in page needs were missing: cross-site cookies, which `login.live.com` relies on, and a `WebChromeClient`, without which the popups and dialogs the flow opens are silently dropped. The iOS build never hit any of this because WKWebView reports itself as Safari and handles those by default.
- **A sign-in page that fails to load now says why.** Main-frame errors were going nowhere, so a failure left the same white screen with nothing to report.

releases.name: v2.5.16 — Minecraft 26.4 snapshots
releases.body:
## What's new

- **Minecraft 26.4 snapshots start.** A version id like `26.4-snapshot-3` splits into `26` and `4-snapshot-3`, and reading that second part as a plain integer gave nothing — so 26.4 was treated as 26.0, missed the SDL and LWJGL 3.4.3 stack, and launched on LWJGL 3.3.6 instead. The game died immediately with `NoClassDefFoundError: org/lwjgl/sdl/SDLPlatform`; the cacio lines in the crash report were a consequence, not the cause. Version numbers are now read digit by digit, so snapshot, pre-release and rc suffixes no longer hide them, and five tests cover the shapes.
- Carries the previous fix as well: on Java 24 and newer the cacio java agent is skipped, because the `sun.misc.Unsafe` calls its `premain` depends on are refused there and a failing agent takes the VM with it.

releases.name: v2.5.15 — Minecraft 26.4 starts again
releases.body:
## What's new

- **Minecraft 26.4 (and anything else on Java 24 or newer) starts again.** The cacio setup loaded a java agent whose `premain` overwrites the AWT toolkit's static fields through `sun.misc.Unsafe` (`staticFieldBase`, `staticFieldOffset`, `putObject`). Those methods are refused from JDK 24 and gone in 26, and a failing agent takes the whole VM down with it — which surfaced as a cacio error at startup.

  The iOS build has always run the same cacio jars without that agent, on the same Java 25, using only `-Dawt.toolkit` and `-Xbootclasspath/a`. Android now does the same on Java 24+ and keeps the agent only for the older runtimes that still need it.

## Lemon-Project v1.6.0

A round of fixes from your logs and reports, plus three things you asked for: a Nintendo button layout for physical controllers, frontends that bring a game's update and DLC along, and the Immediate GPU fences back as an option for advanced users.

# Hokkaido 0.6.5

Tested on a Samsung Galaxy S26 (Exynos 2600, Xclipse 960, 12 GB) and, for the first time, a Galaxy S25 (Snapdragon 8 Elite, Adreno 830, 12 GB), both on Android 17. The performance work tested on the S26's Exynos carries over well to Snapdragon.

# Hokkaido 0.6.4

Tested on a Samsung Galaxy S26 (Exynos 2600, Xclipse 960, 12 GB) and a Galaxy S24 (Exynos 2400, Xclipse 940, 8 GB), both on Android 17.

- **Stability** (upstream)
  - Closing a game while its shaders load no longer hangs, and the next launch works.

releases.name: Dual-Screen 3.0.2 (based on Dusklight v2.0.0)
releases.body:
Restores compatibility with third-party native mods. If mods failed to load, or loaded and then force-closed the game, this is the fix.

### Fixed

* **Mods failed to load with "Unknown mod load failure".** ([#6](https://github.com/igawa6/dusklight/issues/6))

  Adding the companion's slot I/II buttons pushed `BTN_R` to `1 << 8` and widened `daAlink_c::itemTriggerCheck` / `itemButtonCheck` from `u8` to `u16`. That changes the mangled names, so mods built against upstream Dusklight could not resolve them and failed at `dlopen`. The upstream symbols are re-exported as forwarders that translate the button numbering as well as the width — upstream's `BTN_B` is `BTN_S2` here, so widening alone would have routed a sword check to a slot button.

  Measured against three mods: only 2 of 842, 762 and 55 game-symbol imports were unresolved.

* **The game force-closed when a loaded mod ran.**

releases.name: Dual-Screen 3.0.1 (based on Dusklight v2.0.0)
releases.body:
Patch release for **Dual-Screen 3.0**. No gameplay or dual-screen changes — the native code is identical to 3.0.

### Fixed

* **Cosmetics, Luau Support and Randomizer were missing from the Android build.** ([#6](https://github.com/igawa6/dusklight/issues/6))

  The Android CMake presets listed only the `dusklight` target, so the `dusklight_mods` aggregate target never ran and `bundled_mods/` was never produced. Gradle packs that directory into `assets/mods`, so the APK shipped with no bundled mod packages at all. Mods that depend on the Luau runtime could not load either.

  All three packages are now present: `cosmetics`, `luau_runtime` and `randomizer`.

  CI was never affected — `build.yml` builds `dusklight_mods` as its own explicit `--target` step. This only broke preset-driven local builds.

  and a quick press throws a single punch.
- On the front of a building, letting go of Circle throws the punch. With the upgrade, even a quick press charged
  all the way into the double punch. As in the original, letting go early gives the single punch, and holding on
  gives the double punch.

Thanks to the player who reported this.

releases.name: RampageRE v1.2.4
releases.body:
RampageRE v1.2.4

Buildings falling by themselves, grabbing and eating, and a few smaller things from the same report.

- Buildings no longer collapse out of nowhere at the start of a city's boss block. In a city played for more than
  eight minutes, the block's time-up airstrike went off as the boss block began, and its bombers flattened the
  tallest towers before you touched them. As in the original, the boss block has no time-up airstrike.
- Nick and Edwin (Dick on the PS2) can grab people and cars. They are the only two monsters without the hand point
  the grab looked for, and came up empty every time.
- What a monster holds hangs from its fist the way the original's does, instead of sinking into the hand. The
  monsters that toss their food into the mouth (Lizzie, Ralph, Leon, Rojo, Wally, Edwin and the others on their
  skeleton) throw people up and into their mouths again.
- Picking up an upgrade says UPGRADE. Taken while a challenge's banner was still up, it showed a red RAMPAGE.
- The singer with the guitar in Las Vegas is heard again after the first time through his song. It went quiet for
  good; as in the original, it starts over when you come back near him.

releases.name: RampageRE v1.2.3
releases.body:
RampageRE v1.2.3

The keyboard's controls, and keys that left the game.

- In a game started from the menus, the number keys, N, M, G and Page Up / Page Down no longer change the city, the
  time of day, the monster or the block. They are the developer build's city viewer keys and had stayed on in the
  game, where a stray press threw you out of the level you were playing.
- The README now lists the keyboard's controls. On the keyboard you punch with J, kick with K and grab with L (Space
  jumps, R roars, W A S D move, the arrows turn the head, P, Enter or Esc pause); a controller plays too.

Thanks to the player who reported it.

jjmhalew-rampagere.latest_body:
RampageRE v1.2.8

The order of a frame, the monsters' moves and the bot partner, checked frame by frame against the original game.

- A frame runs in the original's order: every monster picks its next move first, then the monsters move, then the
  people, the traffic and the buildings, then the monsters' blows on each other. A kick on the bot partner now
  lands on the same frame as in the original, and its reaction starts a frame sooner.
- A move that blends into the next one keeps the old move going for 2 more frames before the new one takes over,
  as in the original. Its animation starts at once, as before; a press during those 2 frames picks from the old
  move, as the original does.
- The monster turns towards the stick one frame later, as in the original. Walks and turns now follow the original's
  path.
- A monster walking or knocked into a building front is held off it before it picks its next move. It used to end
  up inside the front for a frame.
- A walk that turns into a punch stops where it is, and a punch that ends in the idle pose no longer slides the
  monster back a little. The idle after a punch now stands where the original's does.

releases.name: 1.0.0 Risshun
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]
> 这是 `1.0.0` 首个正式版。电脑端改用系统 WebView2 并提供安装包与便携模式，双端新增游戏封面、手动备份与按次选择写入前备份，并从本版本起保持 `1.x` 期间的设置与备份兼容。

## 升级说明

> [!CAUTION]
> **从 `0.x` 升级必须重新配置；Android 必须先卸载再安装。**
> - **Android 端**：本版本更换了应用签名密钥，无法直接覆盖安装 `0.x` 版本，请**先卸载旧版再安装 `1.0.0`**。卸载会一并删除游戏设置、目录授权和 `Android/data/io.github.galgame.savedatasync/files/backups/` 下的备份，升级前请先将需要保留的备份复制到其他位置，或先恢复所需存档。
> - **Windows 端**：配置与数据改存至新目录（配置位于 `%APPDATA%\galgame-savedata-sync\`，游戏、设备和备份默认位于 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\galgame-savedata-sync\`），**不迁移 `0.x` 测试版的数据**，升级后需要重新添加游戏、连接设备并关联。原 `0.x` 版本位于 `%APPDATA%\存档同步\` 的文件不会被删除，需要时可手动取回或清理。

- **两端必须一起升级**：通信协议与能力版本已更新，旧版设备会显示为版本不同，无法连接或传输。
- **从 `1.0.0` 起保持数据与备份兼容**：此后 `1.x` 版本升级将保留游戏配置、设备关联与备份，且 `1.0.0` 起写入的备份可在整个 `1.x` 内列出和恢复；两台设备需处于同一主次版本（例如均为 `1.0.x`）才能连接。若用旧版应用打开由更新版本写入的数据，应用会保持数据不变并提示安装最新版本后再打开。
- **Windows 分发包调整**：提供 `SavedataSync-1.0.0-Setup-x64.exe` 安装包（支持只为当前用户或所有用户安装，缺少 WebView2 时自动下载安装）和 `SavedataSync-1.0.0-Portable-x64.zip` 免安装版（在 `SavedataSync.exe` 同级目录新建 `portable_data` 文件夹可启用便携模式，数据随程序保存）。

## 新功能

- **游戏封面**：游戏卡片可显示竖版封面。在“游戏设置”的“封面”一行中，支持从 VNDB、NextMoe、Bangumi 和 Steam 在线搜索封面（NextMoe 可先选作品再选封面），也支持从本机选取图片或移除封面；从对端导入游戏时，会一并取回对方已设置的封面。

releases.name: 0.5.0 Interconnected Devices
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]
> 这一版起，同一网络内的任意两台设备都能互相连接、互传存档：电脑可以连接另一台电脑，Android 也能开启本机服务，让电脑或其他手机连进来。连接后两端都能发起传输。

## 升级说明

> [!CAUTION]
> **升级后需要重新设置游戏和设备。** 配置格式已变更，读不了 0.4.0 的配置，覆盖安装后应用会报配置错误。
> 电脑端删除 `%APPDATA%\存档同步\game-library.json`；Android 清除应用数据，或卸载后重新安装。之后重新添加游戏、连接设备并关联。
> Android 清除应用数据或卸载会一并删除 `Android/data/io.github.galgame.savedatasync/files/backups/` 下的备份，需要保留时先把这个文件夹复制到其他位置。

- **两端必须一起升级**：通信协议与 0.4.0 不兼容，旧版设备会显示为版本不同，无法连接。
- **写入前备份改为默认关闭**：被覆盖的文件默认不保留，需要备份时在“设置”中开启。关闭备份时开始传输不再弹出确认。

## 新功能

- **电脑连接其他设备**：电脑的设备页会搜索附近的设备，也可以手动输入地址连接，两台电脑之间可以互传存档。已保存的设备在原地址连不上时，会按设备查找 5 秒并改用新地址。
- **Android 本机服务**：在设备页点击“启动本机服务”后显示地址和连接二维码，电脑和其他手机可以连进这台手机。服务由常驻通知保持，应用切到后台后仍能被连接、接收传输，也可以从通知停止。服务停止时可以换端口。
- **任意一端发起传输**：连接后两端都能发起传输并选择方向，包括两台 Android 之间。每台设备同一时间只连接一台设备。
- **对方自动打开传输详情**：传输开始时，另一端也会切到这次传输的详情页。
- **修改日期提示**：Android 未开启“直接读写文件”、计划里又有文件要写入手机时，计划页或传输详情会显示黄色提示，可以直接去开启权限。
- **导入游戏默认用对方的游戏名**：从另一端导入游戏时，名称默认填对方设备上的游戏名。

## 修复与改进

- Android 未开启“直接读写文件”时，电脑向手机覆盖大量文件不再随文件数成倍变慢。以前覆盖约 500 个文件、97 MiB 需要近 8 分钟。
- 附近的设备停止服务后，约 10 秒内从“附近的设备”列表消失。以前会一直显示，点“连接”才失败。
- 本机服务的端口被占用时，提示换一个端口后重试；Android 停止本机服务后马上再开启不再失败。
- 和文件无关的程序内部错误改为提示“应用内部出错，请重试；仍然失败时重启应用”，不再提示读写文件失败。

releases.name: 0.4.0 Faster Sync
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]
> 这一版主要提速：比较只看文件大小和修改日期，不再逐个计算哈希；内容边打包边发送、边收边解包，接收端的备份与传输同时进行。Android 授予“所有文件访问权限”后直接读写存档目录，扫描、备份和写入都快很多。

## 升级说明

- 可直接覆盖安装 0.3.1，设备、游戏和备份设置都会保留。备份设置格式已升级，旧版应用读不了，不支持降级。
- **两端必须一起升级**：比较和传输协议与 0.3.x 不兼容，一端是旧版时会在开始传输前提示更新两端。
- **Android 最低版本提高到 Android 11。**

## 新功能

- **按大小和修改日期比较**：两端文件大小相同、修改日期相差不超过 2 秒即视为相同，扫描只列目录，不再读取文件内容计算 SHA-256。写入后目标文件的修改日期设为来源的修改日期，下次比较显示相同。
- **流式传输**：发送端直接把文件打包进网络流，接收端边收边解包，本机不再生成快照或压缩包。数据不完整或中途断开时目标不变。
- **备份与传输并行**：接收端登记任务后马上开始备份，同时接收内容，备份完成且内容收齐后再写入。进度分为备份、传输、写入三段。
- **备份阶段显示百分比**：两端界面和 Android 通知在备份时都显示进度，不再一直转圈。
- **Android 所有文件访问权限**：授权后游戏目录直接按路径读写，不经 SAF。设置页显示授权状态并可跳到系统授权页，首次添加游戏后会提示一次；未授权时照常经 SAF 读写。

## 修复与改进

- 备份和写入去掉多余的重读、逐文件 fsync 和反复列目录，Android 扫描、备份和打包时同时打开多个文件。约 500 个文件、100 MiB 的存档目录，两端备份从约 5 分钟降到数秒。
- 备份按游戏归组：重新选择游戏目录后，旧目录的备份照常列出、参与轮换，也能恢复到当前目录。
- “重新扫描”沿用上次传输的方向，不再回到默认的电脑传移动端。
- 一端取消传输时两端都记为已取消，另一端不再显示“传输失败：网络连接中断”。
- 手机上传途中断网时两端都按网络中断结束，不再报“请求内容无效”或被电脑记为用户取消。
- 手机作为发送端时可以看到电脑的备份进度，不再一直显示“正在备份 0%”。
- 手机发送途中断网或应用被结束时，电脑不再卡住到 30 分钟期限才能开始新的比较和传输。
- 对方存档目录改名后又改回，刷新即可重新比较，不用断开重连。
- 移动端刚连上时连点“连接”不再断开刚建立的连接。
- 电脑写入途中被强制结束留下的临时文件，比较时跳过，下次写入时清理。
- 任务结果和进度文案更准确：文件、文件夹和删除分开计数；取消时没执行的文件不再算失败；结果待确认时不再显示“部分完成”；等待对方设备时有单独说明；错误写明出错的是哪一端。

releases.name: 0.3.1 Seamless Connection
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]
> 这一版完成“连接与重连”：Android 不用再手动输入 IP，可以从附近设备列表或扫码连接电脑；电脑换了地址后，Android 点“连接”会自动找到新地址重连。

## 新功能

- **局域网发现**：电脑端服务运行时在局域网广播本机，Android 设备页的“附近”列表会列出同一网络中的电脑，点一下即可连接。
- **扫码连接**：电脑端设备页显示连接二维码，Android 扫码即可连接。二维码带多个候选地址，推荐地址不可用时会依次尝试其他地址；深色主题下二维码随主题变色。
- **设备页重新设计（两端）**：电脑端显示服务卡片、二维码和推荐地址，推荐地址优先取物理网卡上有默认网关的地址；已保存的设备按最近连接排序，在附近的设备会标出来。
- **换地址后自动重连**：电脑因 DHCP 或换网络改了 IP、端口时，Android 点已保存设备的“连接”，会在连接原地址的同时在后台按设备 ID 查找这台电脑；原地址连不上就自动连接新地址并更新保存的地址，游戏和目录设置都保留。
- **界面用语**：两端改用“本机”“对方设备”或设备名称来称呼双方，不再按“电脑”“移动端”区分。

## 修复与改进

- 修正 Windows Portable 包缺少模块、无法启动的问题。
- 电脑端只显示按默认网关和路由优先级推荐的 IPv4 地址，不再列出虚拟网卡等无关地址。
- 对方设备异常断开（如电脑端停止服务）后立即点“连接”，不再提示“正在执行其他任务”。
- 设备页加载图标与文字对齐，标“在附近”的行与其他行等高。
- 开屏动画立绘更新，适配平板等大屏设备。

## 升级说明

- 可直接覆盖安装 0.3.0，存档、设备和游戏设置都会保留。
- 两端请一起升级：0.3.0 的电脑端不会广播，Android 的“附近”列表搜不到它，二维码也需要新版电脑端显示。

## 已知限制

- 发现依赖局域网组播（mDNS，UDP 5353）。路由器开启 AP 隔离、访客网络或屏蔽组播时搜不到设备，需用扫码或手动输入地址连接。
- Windows 首次运行时可能弹出防火墙提示，需要允许专用网络访问，否则 Android 无法连接电脑。
- 对方地址没有回应时（例如防火墙丢弃请求），连接约 5 秒后才提示失败。
- 扫码需要授予 Android 相机权限。
- Windows Portable 版和 APK 未经商店分发，首次运行时系统可能提示来源未知。

* * *

> [!NOTE]

releases.name: 0.3.0 Experience Enhancement
releases.body:

releases.body:
## Added NetPlay Public Rooms

Until now, NetPlay worked over the internet with no account, no relay, and no service to trust. The one thing it could not do was find you an opponent: you still had to know someone already, and swap an IP address with them by hand.

**Public Rooms** is that missing half. It's an optional board where hosts advertise the game they are hosting, so anyone with the same ROM can tap it and connect.

What it is *not* is a relay. The board introduces two players and then steps out of the way — the match still runs directly between the two devices, exactly as it did before, and nothing about it passes through any server of mine. 

### On the board

* **Room codes.** Every room gets a short code you can pass to a friend. 
* **PIN rooms.** Tick *Require PIN* and the room still appears, marked as protected, but only the people you told can get in. The PIN itself never reaches the server — only a hash of it does.
* **A color-coded connection forecast.** Green, amber, or red per room, based on what STUN actually measured about both routers rather than a guess. Two symmetric NATs with no way through show red and refuse the join.

**Console Five Pro v0.0.9proQ4** — an independent rebranded build of CapyPS5 v0.0.3, the first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android (built on KytyPS5 and the FEX x86-64 JIT).

## v0.0.9proQ4 — the freeze fix, the after-freeze crash, frame flow in heavy 3D (same graphics)
- **Fixed: the multi-second freezes.** A draw whose pipeline was still compiling used to block the renderer with an *unbounded* wait on the compile queue. A storm of first-visit pipelines (a new area, material streaming, one-shot LUT passes) could then park the whole renderer behind the workers for tens of seconds - the field logs show 14-28 s of frozen video and starved audio right before the session died. No draw waits more than `debug.capy.pipeline_wait_ms` (default 4 ms, 0 = never wait) now: past the bound the draw is skipped, the compile lands in the background, and the next occurrence draws for real. Every pipeline miss is queued to the async workers - the renderer never compiles inline during play.

Fifth beta of the Android port of the PS5 version of **Plants vs. Zombies: Replanted** (AnyPS5 + Box64 + Turnip). Installs over earlier betas, game data and settings are kept.

> ⚠️ The game is not included — you need your own legally obtained, **decrypted** PS5 dump (PPSA29802).

### Fixes
- **A second player (2P) joined when pausing.** The game opens a second ("special") pad port, and it got the same input as the real pad, so Options there counted as player 2 joining. Only the standard port is the pad now.
- **Touches beside the on-screen buttons acted as a mouse**, a second input device for the game. The touch controls are the only player-1 input now (a real mouse or keyboard still works once used).

### Performance and heat
- **Built-in Turnip updated to Mesa 26.3** with our patch for importing the game's memory directly (no per-draw copies). If you picked another driver in *Settings → GPU driver*, switch back to **Built-in**: drivers without this import copy memory on every draw.

### Fixes
- **Missing graphics and crashes on scene changes** (starting a level, the money bag at the end of a level): results the GPU writes back into game memory were silently skipped on pages the driver's write tracking had protected, so the game read stale or zero data. ## The Dynamax crash and the crash when changing your lead Pokémon

- **The game no longer closes when one of its memory areas runs out.** Sword and Shield keep fixed-size memory areas for things like effects, textures and lists. On Android some of them filled up, and the game then used memory it never got and closed. That was the Dynamax crash, the crash when changing the first Pokémon in your team, and several other crashes in the middle of play. ## Mali: the white screen is fixed

- **Sword and Shield now draw correctly on Mali phones with Arm's own driver** (the phone's normal driver). The field, grass and lighting were white. The game stores some per-vertex data, such as normals and colours, as small whole numbers; Arm's driver changed those numbers before the game's shaders could read them, and the lighting came out far too bright. They now reach the shaders unchanged, as on the Switch. You no longer need the PanVK driver for this. (#215, #227, #282, #311, #316)
- If you turned on any of the menu's "White screen tests (Mali)", turn them off again.

## SkyNetEmu 0.2.4

Source revision: `c57e7f5d7608691bde97bc1c523c22ddf25604c6` (version code 7, version name `0.2.4-stable+c57e7f5`). A small update to 0.2.3.

### Fixes

- **Frame generation is smooth again when the game runs below half the screen's refresh rate.** The FPS counter used to double, but each generated frame and the real one reached the screen on back-to-back refreshes (about 8 ms apart, then a 25 ms gap), so motion looked no smoother than without frame generation. releases.body:
## SkyNetEmu 0.2.2

Source revision: `48f360d1edca3859f72e447e6943a21ee8eede91` (version code 5, version name `0.2.2-stable+48f360d`).

### Fixes and improvements

**Same game presets on every phone**
- Game presets are no longer limited to particular processors, and the Snapdragon-specific BeamNG Box64 presets are gone. Every phone sees the same presets.
- Presets no longer name a GPU driver; the app picks one for your GPU:
  - Linux games get a Turnip driver when a preset is imported, when a shortcut is created and when a game starts. Adreno 735, 740 and 750 get Mesa Turnip 26.2.2; Adreno 730 gets Turnip v27.0.0 r6; Adreno 8xx keeps its current driver.
  - Windows games get the driver mapped to your GPU when they start, or the system driver when none is mapped.

**Crashes**
- Games no longer crash with SIGSYS on Android versions whose system-call filter refuses calls FEX makes (all FEX + bionic BeamNG starts on a POCO F6 with Android 14 died this way). A refused call now fails normally and is logged to `Winlator/logs/sigsys.log`.
- BeamNG 0.34 now starts on Box64 + bionic without PRoot. It used to crash about a second after start with exit 134 (seen on a OnePlus 11).

releases.name: SkyNetEmu 0.2.1
releases.body:
## SkyNetEmu 0.2.1

Source revision: `e750c469bed4a87644a1dac43ff7e1a137d32120` (version code 4, version name `0.2.1-stable+e750c46`).

### Fixes and improvements

**Counter-Strike 2**
- CS2 starts again on a fresh install. The game stopped with "A game file appears to be missing or corrupted" because its Panorama text library could not load next to the root filesystem's newer HarfBuzz. The app now carries the six small font libraries it needs (unmodified Debian 11 builds of HarfBuzz, FriBidi, libthai, libdatrie, Graphite2 and Pixman) instead of relying on Valve's Steam Linux Runtime 3.0 (sniper) being installed.
- The menu's background videos play from a Steam library on shared storage. The x86-64 and 32-bit x86 shims were missing the `flock` fallback that the aarch64 one already had, so file locks failed on shared storage.

**BeamNG.drive**
- BeamNG 0.39 and 0.40 now offer a single preset: FEX + bionic, no PRoot, direct launch, 960x544. The Box64, Box64 bionic, SoC-specific Box64 and Windows ARM64 presets are removed from those two versions; older BeamNG versions keep theirs.

releases.name: SkyNetEmu 0.2.0
releases.body:
## SkyNetEmu 0.2.0

Source revision: `5e2bcd1806815831a04d18b2b843735200461d0f` (version code 3, version name `0.2.0-stable+5e2bcd1`).

### Fixes and improvements

**Linux games on Android**
- Linux games can run on the bionic FEX without PRoot (direct FEX bridge), with game profiles and presets for BeamNG.drive 0.34, 0.39 and 0.40, Shadow of the Tomb Raider, Rise of the Tomb Raider, Dead Island Definitive Edition, Alien: Isolation and Counter-Strike 2. A Box64 + bionic + no PRoot preset starts BeamNG 0.39 reliably.
- Games run directly from shared storage: FEX retries file mappings that Android's noexec storage refuses, so BeamNG no longer needs staged copies. The old staging code is removed, and its leftover files are deleted when a Linux session starts.
- Steam libraries on shared storage (`SkyNetEmu/Games`): installs work, installed games get shortcuts, and a fresh install finds games that are already downloaded there instead of offering to download them again.
- Tomb Raider (2013, 32-bit) runs from a shared-storage library on the PRoot glibc FEX.
- Android 16: FEX and the shim emulate `openat2` and `faccessat2` (BeamNG exited with SIGSYS).

  * Improved Mindlink support.

releases.body:
This release adds a bundled driver for Snapdragon 8 Elite, brings back the audio presets that were missing from 0.6.0, fixes DLC imports and GPU hangs, lets each touch control be resized, and redesigns the launcher.

## Graphics

- **Adreno 8xx driver for Snapdragon 8 Elite.** A source-built Mesa 26.3 Turnip with a fix for the newer Qualcomm gralloc, which otherwise leaves the whole image garbled on Adreno 830. Auto selects it on SM8750 devices unless an imported driver is chosen, and it always renders with `TU_DEBUG=sysmem,nobin`. On Adreno 830 it measured about 12 ms of GPU time per frame at 100% resolution, compared with about 26 ms on the stock driver. Other Adreno 8xx GPUs can select it manually; it has only been validated on Adreno 830.
- **High refresh rate displays.** The game requests the display's fastest mode and passes the FPS option to Android, so FPS settings above 60 are no longer capped at 60 by vsync on 120 Hz phones.

releases.name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.6.0
releases.body:
- Fixed DLC imports after the base game is installed, including DLC-only ZIPs/folders and ZIPs left in to_install by older builds (issue #162). Packs are hash-checked in a temporary tree before replacement; previous packs can be recovered after an interrupted replacement.
- Accepted HMM JSON schemas with trailing commas, comments and a UTF-8 BOM; schema errors no longer dump the complete file (issue #93).
- Added a persisted game-storage choice for internal memory, app folders and Android/media folders on mounted volumes, including SD cards. Optional verified copying keeps the original game, mods, settings and saves (issue #90).
- Added missing translations in English, Russian, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese and Portuguese, including mod settings, updates, storage selection and localized file/installer errors.
- Fixed overlapping guest memory copies with `memmove`, addressing the ring crash and broken collision triggers (PR #158 fix by [puopg (Michael Chen)](https://github.com/puopg)).
- Removed the earlier small-block quarantine and collision repair workarounds alongside that fix (PR #158).

releases.name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.5.3
releases.body:
small update

### Vulkan driver profiles

- Added **Adreno 8xx Experimental (sysmem+flushall)** as a separate, non-default launcher choice.
- The new profile uses the bundled whitebelyash Mesa 26.2 gen8-capable driver and forces the exact `TU_DEBUG=sysmem,flushall` workaround for artifact-prone Adreno 8xx devices.

### Android audio presets

- Added an experimental **POCO F8 Ultra (low latency)** preset. It reduces the internal FIFO cushion from 16 to 8 guest audio frames (about 85 ms to 43 ms) and requests AAudio's exclusive low-latency path to avoid HyperOS selecting an approximately 80 ms shared hardware burst.
- The existing **Default** and **AYN** behavior is unchanged. The POCO-specific path is opt-in because it may crackle, stall or lose sound on devices whose AAudio/MMAP implementation is unreliable.
- The selected preset, resolved FIFO parameters, AAudio performance/sharing modes, hardware burst, active buffer and platform xrun count are written to the Android log.

releases.name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.5.2
releases.body:

- Added periodic update checks and a manual **Check for updates** button.
- The launcher shows release notes and download progress, verifies GitHub's SHA-256 digest when present, and rejects APKs with a different package name or Android signing certificate.
- Installation is handed to Android's system installer; game files, saves, mods and settings stay in place.

### ISO / update / DLC installation (PR #78)

releases.name: The Sims 2 for Android 0.3.1-dev
releases.body:
The Sims 2 for Android **0.3.1-dev** improves Lua error handling, material creation, renderer diagnostics, texture conversion, and the launcher. Changes since **0.3-dev**, from signed source commit `a84f6585caca7a90afe140540714f879800c33bb`.

One APK includes **arm64-v8a** and experimental **armeabi-v7a**. The minimum requirements are now **Android 8.0 (API 26)** and **OpenGL ES 3.1**; the native Vulkan renderer accepts **Vulkan 1.0**. Game data must come from a compatible The Sims 2 Legacy Collection installation. Android 8.0–8.1 and GLES 3.1-only devices still need further device testing.

## Stability and startup

- Fixed the embedded MSVC `setjmp/longjmp` implementation used by Lua: returning to an error handler now unwinds the actual native call stack as well as restoring guest state. The bridge covers all 34 original setjmp call sites and both longjmp epilogues.
- Handle nested and repeated Lua errors, restore exception state, and remove jump contexts when their function returns, a C++ handler unwinds past them, or their thread ends. A jump to a function that has already returned is diagnosed.

releases.name: The Sims 2 for Android 0.3-dev
releases.body:
One APK now supports both **arm64-v8a** and experimental **armeabi-v7a**. The port requires Android 10 or later, OpenGL ES 3.2, and game data from a compatible The Sims 2 Legacy Collection installation. ARM32 also requires Thumb-2, NEON, and 4 KiB kernel pages. Android chooses the ABI, and the app unpacks the matching XZ-compressed engine on first use.

## Graphics and performance

- Fixed flickering and missing objects on Mali-G51 in OpenGL ES. The workaround defaults to on and can be changed in Advanced renderer settings. Fixed a related driver hang reproduced on Mali-T830.
- OpenGL ES compiles and links uncached shader programs in the background, reducing stalls when zooming out, rotating the camera, or changing floors.
- The in-game **Minimal Graphics** preset lowers 11 settings to reduce memory use. It saves the previous values, persists across restarts, and restores those values when switched off.
- **Android performance hints (ADPF) are off by default.** The launcher still lets you turn them on for the next game start.

releases.name: The Sims 2 for Android 0.2.1-dev
releases.body:
## What's new since 0.2-dev

- **Vulkan textures.** DXT1, DXT3, and DXT5 now use the correct BC formats on drivers that support them. This fixes colored noise on terrain, roads, and trees seen on Adreno 735 with both the system Vulkan driver and Turnip.
- **OpenGL ES.** Fixed dynamic buffer updates that could corrupt neighborhood chooser panels and text on Adreno 650 and 735, and the neighborhood HUD on Adreno 650.
- **Vulkan UI scaling.** The APK now includes precompiled SPIR-V variants for FSR 1 UI scaling for all 81 pixel shader entries and the built-in fixed-function pixel shader. Shaders outside the library, including shaders used by some mods, can still be compiled on the device.
- **Shader coverage.** The bundled library grew from 194 to 380 captured shaders and from 215 to 408 entries, including sampler variants. The updated capture tool checks bytecode hashes and records sampler variants. A strict diagnostic mode and a library format check help verify coverage.

## Install or update

Download the APK below or check for updates in the launcher. This build supports ARM64 devices running Android 10 or later and requires compatible The Sims 2 Legacy Collection game files.

releases.name: The Sims 2 for Android 0.2-dev
releases.body:
## What's new since 0.1.2-dev

- **Graphics.** The port's own OpenGL ES 3.2 and Vulkan 1.1 renderers handle Direct3D 9 calls. OpenGL ES is the default. Vulkan supports the system driver, bundled Turnip or PanVK on compatible devices, and imported drivers. DXVK has been removed.
- **Graphics settings.** Both renderers support render scaling, FXAA, MSAA, FSR 1 for the scene and interface, and the launcher’s ETC2 and ASTC texture cache. Existing FSR 3.1 selections switch to FSR 1.
- **PowerVR performance.** OpenGL ES buffer handling reduces severe frame-rate drops on affected PowerVR devices.
- **Lower-latency audio.** The game's EA SND mixer outputs directly to Android AAudio. DirectSound emulation has been removed.
- **Mods folder.** The launcher shows the folder for .package mods and lets you copy its path. Mods in subfolders are supported.
- **Touch input.** The on-screen keyboard opens when you tap previously blocked text fields, including pet names.
- **Loading screens.** Startup captions and town and lot loading animations follow the original game timing.

releases.name: Disco Elysium port v0.10.0
releases.body:
## No more blinking objects after loading

While the game is running, each new combination of shader and render state needs a GPU pipeline. Pipelines the app has never seen are built in the background so the game doesn't freeze, and until one is ready the objects that use it are not drawn. Until now that also happened to pipelines it had already built in an earlier session. Only the first 4,000 were prepared at start-up, in the order they first appeared, so later in the game whole areas came from the background again. The result was objects and textures blinking for a few frames after loading a save or when walking into an area.

- Pipelines that the app has already built on your device are now created on the spot, in about a quarter of a millisecond each and within a small per-frame budget, so they are drawn from the first frame.
- Start-up preparation now begins with the pipelines your last session used (`pipelines_recientes.bin` in the game folder), not with the ones from the beginning of the game.
- Areas you visit for the very first time can still show an object a moment late while its pipeline is built. The second visit is clean.

releases.body:
## 1.0.3 社区发布

本版整合已测试的图形、声音和缓存优化，提供 Android ARM64 安装包与社区应用包。游戏数据由使用者自行准备，应用通过 ARM64 原生执行、HLE 服务桥接及 NVN → Vulkan 兼容层运行。

## 更新内容

- 请求低延迟音频输出，并处理设备拒绝请求时的回退。RG477M 同场景计入应用排队后的时间戳推算播放等待，旧模式约 215 毫秒，本版运行层两轮约 101、137 毫秒。
- 缓存原生模块的分配器导出位置，改进纹理描述符 ID 查找，缩小已证明写回范围的缓存维护。
- 失效描述符缓存的 CPU 元数据按每帧最多 512 项分批清理，清理安排在 GPU 提交和限帧等待之间。

## 本版更新

- 整合声音、对白、亮度、纹理、植被显示与运行时内存修复，混音器默认启用。
- 修正 Mali 顶点整数属性与着色器输入类型匹配，RG477M 人物已可正常显示。
- Mali 默认使用原游戏 960×540 三维渲染档位，目标 30 帧。采用缓存读回和两项着色器等价整理，事件延迟发布和大缓冲写跟踪默认关闭。用户已确认这一配置天空无闪烁。
- 天玑 MT68/MT69 默认保留原游戏分配器空指针判断，避免地址位判断破坏分配器状态。
- 虚拟手柄参照同作者 FFRS 项目，支持显示切换、长按编辑、拖动布局、大小与透明度保存。保留原游戏存档。金手指计划后续加入。
- 桌面应用图标采用自有几何山形图案。版本号由本轮整理设为 1.0.1-preview，code 2。

## 实测与已知问题

RG477M / MT6897 / Mali-G615 / Android 14 已验证安装、原版 Ver1.07 标题、声音恢复、人物显示、开场至户外与城镇流程、虚拟手柄和原游戏存档缩略图。图形组件测试 64 项中 63 通过、1 项缺私有输入跳过，运行时 8 项通过。

当前复杂户外与城镇仍有明显掉帧，尚未达到稳定 30 帧。无闪烁配置的户外采样约 21～25 帧，复杂城镇约 10～20 帧，首次加载和过图仍可能停顿。曾接近 30 帧的事件延迟实验会出现天空条纹，因此发布配置关闭该实验。完整游戏流程与长时间稳定性仍待验证。

其他天玑机型仍待逐机实测。荣耀平板沿用原有设备分支，本轮按用户要求暂停荣耀真机回归。

## 下载和安装

直接安装 `snk-the1st-1.0.1-preview-arm64.apk`。社区转发可使用 `snk-the1st-1.0.1-preview-community.zip`，其中包含 APK、安装说明、版权与免责说明、完整第三方许可和构建清单。使用 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 校验下载内容。

应用包名 `org.snk.the1st.gamewindow`，arm64-v8a，当前为预览调试签名包。覆盖安装前请备份自己的原游戏存档，签名不匹配时先核实旧包来源。

使用者自行准备合法取得并完整合并的 v1.0.7 数据，目录内应包含四个 NSO、RomFS 与配套转换着色器。具体目录与按键操作见随包《安装与使用》。
